mutations.name: splitlines
mutations.replace:
*done, rest = rest.splitlines(keepends=False) + [""] if rest.endswith("\n") else (rest.splitlines() or [""])
        out.extend(done)
mutations.why: str.splitlines also breaks on U+2028 and U+2029, the readline bug

mutations.name: decode-per-chunk
mutations.why: a character split across chunks is corrupted

mutations.name: drop-last
mutations.find:
if rest:
        out.append(rest[:-1] if rest.endswith("\r") else rest)
mutations.why: no final newline loses the last record
